videos.title: Christmas Village Oil Painting (Condensed Tutorial)
videos.description:
This "Christmas Village" oil painting was panted in 3, 8 hour days (Total of 24 hours) on an 16 inch x 20 inch stretched canvas. I wanted to capture the soft glow of the street lamps, home and church lights reflecting out into the snow. The townsfolk walk past each other to discus the joyous Christmas season and the beauty of the landscape in which they live. 

Influential credit: This painting has been replicated by a few high end artists one of which is Thomas Kinkade. I have added and subtracted some items to keep it unique and updated for the present time period. 

Supplies:
OIL PAINTS: (Bob Ross)
Alizarin Crimson, Bright Red, Cadmium Yellow, Yellow Ochre, Indian Yellow, Phthalo Green, Prussian Blue, Phthalo Blue, Dark Sienna, Van Dyke Brown, Midnight Black, and Titanium White

Mediums:
Liquid White, Odorless Paint Thinner, Linseed Oil
 
Brushes / Knives
Medium Painting Knife
Miscellaneous small rounds, small flats, 
liner brush
